ALGORITHM & PHYSICAL MODELS

Multi-hazard safe routing you can verify

01

Measured NASA DEMs

Uses real MRO HiRISE (~1 m) and Mars 2020 CTX (20 m) stereo DEMs controlled to MOLA. Aggregation preserves maximum native cell slope, local 3×3 Laplacian surface roughness, and 8-azimuth horizon sky-view shielding.

02

Multi-hazard edge cost

Every 8-connected graph transition evaluates energy (rolling + climb + cabin thermal + wind chill), transit time (slope, roughness, dust visibility & night penalties), radiation dose (GCR + SPE attenuated by CO₂ column, terrain sky-view & shielding), and shelter distance.

03

Constrained A* / Pareto

Searches an 8-neighbour graph with strict diagonal corner-blocking using an admissible physical lower bound. When unconstrained optima exceed battery, time, or radiation dose budgets, exact nondominated Pareto labels find the best feasible path.

04

Dijkstra verification

Unconstrained graph solutions are independently cross-checked against zero-heuristic Dijkstra search to certify zero optimality gap within IEEE-754 floating-point precision, alongside alternative strategies (Safest, Balanced, Energy, Fastest, Shortest).

Mathematical formulation & operational scope

J(e) = α · R(e) + β · E(e), R(e) = w_s·R_slope + w_r·R_rough + w_rad·D_µSv + w_w·R_weather + w_th·R_thermal + w_sh·R_shelter

Atmospheric column mass σ(z) = (P₀ · exp(−Δz / H) / g) · 0.1 g/cm² scales MSL Curiosity RAD galactic cosmic ray baseline (~27.9 µSv/h) and solar particle event flux with hull/suit areal shielding and local terrain horizon occlusion. Energy E = Σ [m·g·Crr·d/η + m·g·max(Δh,0)/η]/3.6×10⁶ + P_hotel·t/1000 kWh.

Scope & honesty notice: Climate grids (MCD 6.2) are seasonal climatology, and radiation values come from an explicit analytical transport parametrization anchored to MSL RAD rather than live orbital dosimetry. Sub-grid rocks, regolith cohesion, and wheel slip require local stereo perception during real surface operations.
